evidence: Filled Add Entry form (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) and submitted; new row "QA Test Entry" appeared immediately in table, entry count went from 5 to 6.
Fields dialog already had Text (Task Name), Number (Priority), Date (Due Date), Checkbox (Completed) fields. Added a new "Notes" Text field via the dialog and it appeared as a new column immediately.

Entered "QA Test Entry" (text), 5 (number), 2026-12-25 (date), checked Completed (checkbox), "Test note" (text); all values saved and displayed correctly: "QA Test Entry, 5, Dec 25, 2026, Yes(check icon), Test note".
Clicked Cards button; view switched from table rows to a grid of cards, each showing the same fields/values with labels; clicked Table to switch back successfully.
Opened Sort menu, selected "Priority"; entries re-ordered ascending (1,1,2,2,3,5) immediately and footer showed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)".

issue: No filter feature exists in the application
actual: Exhaustively inspected the UI (banner, toolbar, Sort menu, Fields dialog) and the full page DOM (searched for the string "filter" case-insensitively) — no filter control, button, or dropdown exists anywhere. Only Sort (by field, whole-list reordering) and a free-text Search box are available; there is no way to apply field-specific inclusion/exclusion criteria (e.g. Priority > 2, Completed = true).

evidence: Focused the drag handle of "Design new landing page" row, used dnd-kit keyboard interaction (Space to pick up, ArrowDown x2, Space to drop). Row moved from position 1 to position 3 as expected; status announced "Draggable item entry-1 was dropped over droppable area entry-3"; all row data remained intact after reorder.

Priority field is a native input[type=number]. Typing text "abc" fails (Playwright: "Cannot type text into input[type=number]"); pressing key "a" left the field value empty (rejected); pressing "4" then "2" correctly set value to "42".

Due Date field is a native input[type=date]. Setting value to invalid date "2026-13-45" (month 13, day 45) resulted in the field value being rejected/cleared (empty string), confirming invalid dates cannot be set.

issue: Missing required-field validation on Add Entry
actual: Opened Add Entry dialog, left Task Name (text field) empty, and clicked "Add Entry" without filling any other custom data. The entry was added successfully with an empty Task Name (row showed blank name, Priority 0, today's date, unchecked, empty Notes) and entry count incremented from 6 to 7. No validation error or block occurred, so an entry with an undefined field was allowed to be added, violating the requirement that field configuration/definition must be complete for an entry to be added.

evidence: After sorting by Priority ascending, all 6 entries remained present with unchanged field values (names, priorities, dates, completed status, notes) — only order changed, no data was modified or lost.

issue: No filter feature exists to evaluate accuracy against
actual: Since no dedicated filter feature exists in the app (see FT-6), filter accuracy/data-loss cannot be verified. The only narrowing mechanism is the free-text Search box, which is a separate feature (IX-17) and does not support field-specific include/exclude criteria.

evidence: All 6 entries and their full field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) displayed identically and completely in both Table view and Card grid view; verified entries matched exactly between views.

Table view shows column header labels per field. Card view shows a label above each value (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) plus type-specific icons: hash icon for Number, calendar icon for Date, check/x icon for Checkbox, distinguishing both label and type clearly.

DOM inspection showed checked entries render a "lucide-check h-4 w-4 text-success" (green check) icon, while unchecked entries render a "lucide-x h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" (muted X) icon — clearly visually distinct.

actual: Clicked the delete (trash) button on two different entry rows; both times the entry was removed immediately from the table with no confirmation dialog, alert, or "Are you sure" prompt appearing at any point. Entry count decremented instantly (7→6 and 6→5) without any user confirmation step.

evidence: Typing "QA" in the search box immediately filtered the table to show only "QA Test Entry" (footer: "1 entry matching \"QA\""); typing "Design" showed only the matching entry; clearing search restored all entries.
Clicking "Priority" in the Sort menu immediately re-sorted the visible list and updated the footer status to "Sorted by Priority (ascending)" with no perceptible delay.
